deployment-flows: Define and manage a project's deployment flows.
deployment-flows create: Define a new deployment flow for a project.
deployment-flows get: Read a deployment flow or one of its fields.
deployment-flows reorder: Change the order of a deployment flow's stages.
deployment-flows set-status: Turn a deployment flow on or off.
deployment-flows stages: List the stages of a deployment flow.
deployment-flows update-stages: Replace the stages of a deployment flow.
deployment-flows validate: Check a deployment flow definition without saving it.
deployment-flows version: Publish a new deployment flow that replaces an old one.
